description: This file defines the 'SecurityPolicy' class which enforces security rules for sandbox mode in Twig templates. It manages allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions, and provides methods to check security constraints for tags, filters, functions, methods, and properties.

classes.name: SecurityPolicy
classes.description: Represents a security policy for Twig's sandbox mode, controlling allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions, and performing security checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the security policy with allowed tags, filters, methods, properties, and functions.

methods.name: setAllowedTags
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed tags.

methods.name: setAllowedFilters
methods.description: Sets the list of allowed filters.

methods.name: setAllowedMethods
methods.description: Sets the allowed methods for classes.

methods.name: checkSecurity
methods.description: Checks if the provided tags, filters, and functions are allowed according to the policy.

methods.name: checkMethodAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a method call on an object is allowed.

methods.name: checkPropertyAllowed
methods.description: Checks if accessing a property on an object is allowed.
